verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grok Bot running on a persistent cloud computer and acting on real services with approval gates (Allow once / Always allow / Deny, Auto Review), plus network egress controls. None of these is a documented sandbox or test environment that keeps the Bot away from production data. The cloud computer is the Bot's normal workspace, not a separate test environment, and approval gating is an adjacent control, not isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
